title: Single-pass external comparisons did not establish a winner
summary: The five-system exploration and corrected four-system comparison exposed configuration differences and similar wait/upstream batch times. Neither establishes a repeatable system ranking.
scope: Corrected four-system study: one run per system, sixteen workflows, 64 responses and 48 tools each, Qwen2.5-7B-AWQ on RTX 2080 Ti.
limitations: Runtimes, chunking, paging, output lengths and instrumentation differ. Continuum decode-publication correction was predeclared; the original false row remains diagnostic. Strict output-format compliance mostly failed.
decision: Keep published-system comparisons and their configuration corrections; do not treat token rate as equal-work throughput or label parity as quality equivalence.

chart.caption: Corrected four-system comparison only. Lower is faster; one run per system, no uncertainty intervals.
